# Andres Rincon (anferiro)

> Andres Rincon is a CTO in fintech (Colombia) with 20+ years of experience as developer, architect and engineering leader. He writes about generative AI adoption, architecture design systems, knowledge graphs and principled leadership.

Site: https://anferiro.me — available in English and Spanish.

## Articles
- [How to Adopt Gen AI?](https://anferiro.me/articles/adopting-generative-ai.html): Responsible adoption of generative AI: principles, human impact and practical steps.
- [¿Cómo adoptar Inteligencia Artificial Generativa?](https://anferiro.me/articles/adopcion-ia-generativa.html): Spanish version of the above.
- [Using AI to Generate Knowledge](https://anferiro.me/articles/using-ai-to-generate-knowledge.html): Deep research with a knowledge graph, Claude and Neo4j.
- [Stop the Red Meeting Madness](https://anferiro.me/articles/red-meeting-madness.html): Strategies to protect your time from unnecessary meetings.
